Visit note | 2025-04-13 02:00 PM | Dr. Saiful Alam, Endocrinology | Patient: Fariha Sheikh, 44, female. Ms. Sheikh reports she has been shedding pounds even though she eats well, and she cannot stand being in warm weather. She works as a police constable and first noticed these changes during a hot summer in Sylhet. She has a history of Hypothyroidism. She reports no neck swelling, eye bulging, or chest pain at rest. On examination: pulse 125 bpm, BP 136/77 mmHg, weight 84 kg. Her thyroid is slightly enlarged and her hands have a fine tremor. Assessment: Hyperthyroidism. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to avoid excess tea and coffee and rest when her heart races. Follow-up in 4 weeks with thyroid function tests.

Visit note | 2025-04-13 02:00 PM | Dr. Asif Mahmud, Dermatology | Patient: Habiba Hossain, 60, female. Mrs. Hossain explains she keeps getting itchy raised bumps that appear and disappear, along with occasional swelling of her lips. Her symptoms started after eating prawns at a restaurant in Uttara. She works as a photographer and has no known medical comorbidities. She denies shortness of breath, dizziness, or abdominal pain. On examination: about 18 welts on the trunk and arms, noting welts appearing only after a hot shower or exercise, BP 130/72 mmHg, pulse 72 bpm, weight 50 kg. Skin tests are otherwise normal. Assessment: Acute urticaria. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to avoid the suspected food, keep a symptom diary, and go to hospital at once if the tongue or throat swells. Follow-up in 2 weeks with the symptom diary.

Visit note | 2025-04-13 02:30 PM | Dr. Tanvir Ahmed, General Medicine | Patient: Parvez Sikder, 19, male. Mr. Sikder states he has a fever that climbs a little higher every day for over a week, accompanied by a coated tongue and dull discomfort in his belly. His illness began a few days after eating street food at a fair in Shyamoli. He works as a shopkeeper and has no prior chronic illnesses. He denies vomiting, loose stools, or chest discomfort. Visit note | 2025-04-13 02:30 PM | Dr. Arif Hossain, Pulmonology | Patient: Nazma Sultana, 74, female. Mrs. Sultana complains of a cough producing yellow or green sputum, high fever, and sharp chest pain whenever she breathes in. Her trouble started after a long cold boat trip near Faridpur. On examination: temperature 102.5°F, BP 116/85 mmHg, pulse 94 bpm, SpO2 91%, weight 57 kg. Auscultation reveals bronchial breathing and crackles in the right lower lung zone. Assessment: Community-acquired pneumonia. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to rest and drink plenty of fluids, and return at once if breathing becomes difficult. Follow-up in 3 days for review and a chest X-ray in 6 weeks.
